name: YFG Greem [Krea]
description: YFG Greem – Green, Grim Post-Recovery Atmosphere Base Model: Krea 2 Style A moody green-and-grim cinematic environmental style built around wet concrete, abandoned infrastructure, dense forest overgrowth, mist, rain, and quiet post-collapse human presence. The overall look feels like a mix of archival post-apocalyptic photography, overgrown brutalist infrastructure, damp Pacific Northwest survivalism, and subdued near-future recovery documentation . Trigger Official trigger: YFG-Greem style The trigger is not required , but it can help. What seems to matter just as much—sometimes more—is describing the aesthetic directly in the prompt with ideas like: rain-soaked overgrown infrastructure misty forest ruins wet concrete brutalism post-collapse transit corridor damp green atmospheric photography abandoned road through dense evergreen forest archival world recovery imagery Strength Tested from 0.5 to 2.0 1.0 – 1.15 is a very solid middle-ground range Lower values keep more of the base model intact Higher values push more aggressively into the Greem mood, color cast, and environmental storytelling Key Characteristics Rain + mist atmosphere – wet surfaces, fog, low visibility, soft diffused overcast light. Green overgrowth – vines, moss, ferns, conifers, forest reclamation, damp vegetation. Brutalist / infrastructural decay – tunnels, bridges, parking decks, roadways, transit structures, concrete corridors. Quiet survivalist presence – lone figures, repair crews, parked utility vehicles, small camps, subtle human activity. Archival-documentary feel – several examples feel like recovered records or environmental documentation from a future world. Prompt Ideas “An abandoned forest transit tunnel in heavy rain, overgrown concrete, YFG-Greem style.” “A brutalist parking structure reclaimed by moss and ferns, cinematic mist, wet asphalt, post-collapse atmosphere.” “Repair workers on a rain-soaked bridge in a dense evergreen forest, archival recovery photograph.” “A lone survivor standing beneath a giant drainage tunnel, overcast light, wet concrete, green ruin aesthetic.” “A forest road crossing an overgrown elevated highway in steady rain, muted green cinematic mood.” Tips & Tricks Describe the mood, not just the subject This model seems to respond very well when you include environmental language like rain, mist, damp air, overgrowth, wet concrete, recovery zone, abandoned transit infrastructure. Infrastructure is a strong fit Tunnels, bridges, roads, parking decks, drainage systems, retaining walls, and transit corridors appear especially aligned with the LoRA’s identity. Use forest + concrete together One of the strongest recurring ideas in the sample set is the combination of dense evergreen wilderness reclaiming human-built infrastructure . Human presence should stay understated Small figures, workers, utility vehicles, survival camps, or lone travelers seem to fit better than busy crowds or highly active scenes. Lean into documentary realism Phrases like “archival photograph,” “world recovery record,” “field documentation,” or “post-collapse environmental survey” may help reinforce the tone. Start around 1.0 to 1.15 Since that range seems to be the sweet spot, it’s probably the best place to begin before adjusting up or down. YFG Greem is a highly atmospheric post-recovery environmental LoRA built around green overgrowth, rain, concrete ruin, and quiet human persistence . It shines when prompts combine damp forest environments with abandoned or repurposed infrastructure , creating scenes that feel like lost records from a grim, beautiful future.
